_about: SHELF of the Mughal histories in English before 1931: H. Beveridge's Akbarnama of Abu'l-Fazl (vols I-II, 1907-12), Blochmann and Jarrett's Ain-i-Akbari (3 vols, 1873-94), Rogers and Beveridge's Tuzuk-i-Jahangiri (2 vols, 1909-14) and Annette Beveridge's Humayun-nama of Gulbadan Begam (1902). Annette Beveridge's Babur-nama is on singles-history-travel. Each title gates on its own translator. Printings before 1931 only; the Asiatic Society's 2000 reprints of the Akbarnama on archive.org are not used. US public domain. Added 2026-10-17 by lane C (round 69); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
_name_words_note: Translator names only: fetch_shelf.py treats them as the identity check.
